question.text: A piece of copper and another of germanium are cooled from room temperature to <math> <mrow> <mtext>77 </mtext> <mtext>K</mtext></mrow></math>. The resistance of

options.text: copper decreases and of germanium increases
copper increases and of germanium decreases

solution.text:
Copper is a conductor.
Germanium is a semiconductor
When cooled, the resistance of copper decreases and that of germanium increases.
